meaning: For an arbitrary actual root: the existing identityOfActualRoot step (q3 a4 dichotomy, no self-causation of distinct esse, esse causes are actual concrete grounds, existing beings are in act) gives represented esse equal to essence; the simply-prior bridge and excluded middle make the root first, so no distinct being is prior to it; component priority and a distinct component in every composite then exclude composition. This generalizes the witnessed-root argument of ROOT-WITHOUT-LIMITING-PRINCIPLE to every actual root and drops its population, whole-roster and dependence inputs, which served only to produce the witness. No existence, necessity or uniqueness of a root is asserted. All eight inputs stay open.
